Why waste your energy convincing people who won't listen?

Kevin explains that he doesn't try to make a pig sing. It only annoys the pig and wastes his time.

He compares it to the movie Jaws, where an expert warns a crowded little boat and nobody listens.

His point: your energy is better spent than on convincing people who aren't ready to hear it.

Who are you still trying to convince?
